description: GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks never reach the published package, so updating one must never release.
The actions scope matches the shared release rule {type: chore, scope: actions, release: false} for patch,
minor and major alike; without it a major bump arrives as chore(deps)!, which releases a major.
devDependencies never reach consumers, so updating one must never release. The literal prefix is needed
because the shared preset's major rule sets commitMessagePrefix 'chore(deps)!: ', which a packageRule can
only override, not unset; 'chore(actions)' maps to release: false in @ivuorinen/semantic-release-config.
The separate group keeps dev updates out of groups that also hold runtime dependencies, whose PR title
would otherwise decide the release for both.
pre-commit hook majors: the shared preset restores the 'chore(actions): ' prefix for github-actions majors
only, so without this a hook major still arrives as 'chore(deps)!: ' and releases a major.
The devDependency on conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits exists only to hoist 9.x to the root, where
@commitlint/config-conventional keeps its own nested 10.x. 10.x needs writer 9: 10.0-10.3 render notes with
only the version heading and 10.4 fails the release. Hold it below 10 until a stable release-notes-generator
